newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline bounces back but lags crude oil rally.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline bounces back but lags crude oil rally.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices bounced back after Thursday's sharp selloff but still lagged the crude oil rally after a week of volatile trading.

Unleaded premium barges ended $1 firmer at $219 fob ARA despite a 50-cent rally in Brent crude this afternoon. Trades were heard done at $218, twice at $219 and at $220, and regular unleaded early at $208, up $2.
One Scandanavian producer was a noted buyer of Eurograde barges again, traders said, but it was unclear if that support would prop up prices early next week.
A trader at a German refinery said fundamentals there looked balanced, with demand in a seasonal slowdown.
"The market looks relatively stable in the mogas concerning the barges in Rotterdam so values could hold," the trader said.
